name: pyconza2026-blog
description: Front-end build for the blog: Tailwind CSS plus vendored htmx and Alpine.js, all written to static/dist/.

scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:css
scripts.build:vendor: mkdir -p static/dist && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/dist/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/dist/alpine.min.js
